welcome.title: Waslah
welcome.line1: Rides and deliveries in your city, from inside Telegram — no app to install.
welcome.line2: You pick your destination and get an estimate from a real route — and when we cannot compute one we say «unavailable» rather than guess.
welcome.line3: Before we start: read the terms and the privacy policy and accept them. The time you accept is recorded.
welcome.language_note: Language changes this screen's text now. Saving it to your account is item F2-11 — we do not claim it is saved today.
welcome.consent_required_hint: Both are required, and each is recorded separately with its own timestamp.
welcome.consent_superseded: The document changed after your earlier consent, so we ask again.
welcome.location_note: We do not ask for location permission on this screen. We ask at the moment it is needed, when you set a destination.
welcome.after_consent_body: The ride request, pricing and tracking screens are not built yet (items F2-02 to F2-12). Your consent really is recorded now, and no request screen waits behind it — we say so plainly instead of showing a button that leads nowhere.
welcome.error.session: Your session expired or was not accepted. Reopen the app from Telegram.
welcome.error.version_not_current: The copy your app is showing is out of date and the document has changed. Reopen the app to read the current version before accepting.
welcome.error.account_not_found: You do not have an account with us yet. Send /start to the bot first, then reopen the app.
welcome.error.unavailable: The consent service is unavailable right now. Nothing was recorded, and retrying is safe.
welcome.error.rejected: The consent was not accepted as sent. Try again, and if it repeats, reopen the app.
consent.terms_of_service.title: Terms of use
consent.terms_of_service.summary: The rules for using the service, what we owe you, what we expect from you, and the limits of our liability.

consent.privacy_policy.summary: What data we collect, why, who sees it, how long we keep it, and how you download your data or delete your account.
